description: This file defines the express routing logic for note-related API endpoints in a note management system. It includes route handlers for listing, searching, retrieving, creating, updating, deleting, and toggling the pin status of notes.

methods.name: notesRouter.get ('/')
methods.description: Handler for listing notes with optional search, pinned filter, and pagination.

methods.name: notesRouter.get ('/search')
methods.description: Handler for searching notes by a text query.

methods.name: notesRouter.get('/:id')
methods.description: Handler for retrieving a single note by its ID.

methods.name: notesRouter.post ('/')
methods.description: Handler for creating a new note.

methods.name: notesRouter.put('/:id')
methods.description: Handler for updating an existing note with partial data.

methods.name: notesRouter.delete('/:id')
methods.description: Handler for deleting a note by ID.

methods.name: notesRouter.post('/:id/pin')
methods.description: Handler for toggling the pinned status of a note.
